# JobQueueOptions interface

Everything a job queue needs to connect and behave, given to every constructor in this package.

Only [JobQueueOptions.name](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueoptions.name/) is required. The rest tune the broker connection, the delivery guarantee and logging, and each carries the default that applies when it is omitted.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface JobQueueOptions 
```

string


</td><td>

Name of the job queue. Required.

This is the queue's identity, not a label: a [JobQueueWorker](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueworker/) and a [JobQueuePublisher](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueuepublisher/) that share a name are two ends of one queue, and two that do not are unrelated queues that will never see each other's jobs.


</td></tr>
